_comment: Pterodactyl Egg for High Quality Telegram Video Downloader Bot (vsd-bot)
name: Telegram Video Downloader Bot
author: eni@antigravity.ai
description: High-performance Telegram bot that downloads videos from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitter/X, Reddit, etc. in OG high quality.
startup: if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt; fi; python main.py

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Pterodactyl installation script
cd /mnt/server
if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then
  pip install -r requirements.txt
fi
echo -e "Installation finished!"

variables.name: Max Concurrent Downloads
variables.description: Number of simultaneous video downloads allowed

variables.name: Max File Size MB
variables.description: Maximum file download limit in Megabytes (Telegram standard bot upload limit is 2000 MB)
